summary: First-run e2e testing for Vantera site. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests passed covering POST /api/contact happy path (+ persistence via GET), invalid email 422, empty name 422, empty message 422, and GET root. Frontend: All four pages (/, /services, /about, /contact) render correct headings ('ENGINEERING THE INTELLIGENCE OF TOMORROW.', 'WHAT WE ENGINEER.', 'A STUDIO WITH A POINT OF VIEW.', 'INITIATE.') and are reachable via navbar links. Home page below-the-fold sections render: SELECTED WORK grid with work-card-01..04, stats strip (40+, 99.98%), MANIFESTO chapters. Contact form submission with data-testids succeeds, shows contact-success 'Received.' state, and the record is persisted (verified through GET /api/contact). Empty-field submission is blocked client-side (no success state, no new backend record).

issues: Headline uses letter-by-letter span animation which breaks Playwright text= selectors (only affects testing convenience; visually fine). Consider adding aria-label or data-testid on hero H1 for testability.
Active nav link visual highlight is done via the numeric badge color; the link element itself does not toggle an 'active' className/data-attribute, making programmatic active-state assertion harder.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add data-testid or aria-label to hero H1s so tests can assert full heading text without depending on letter-span structure.
(Optional/minor) Add data-active attribute or 'active' className on the active nav link for easier programmatic detection.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan handler.
server.py: created_at is stored as ISO string but response_model coerces back to datetime on GET (OK). Consistent, but consider storing as native BSON datetime for sortability across timezones.
server.py: CORS allow_origins from env is '*' but combined with allow_credentials=True can be rejected by some browsers; either drop credentials or use explicit origin list in production.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of TEST_-prefixed contact_messages documents via pytest and one UI submission (TEST_UI_User_ABC123).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_contact.py is reusable and hits public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend uses Lenis smooth scroll with window.__lenis.scrollTo(y) working. Hero H1s use split-letter spans; do not rely on Playwright text= for headline strings — use evaluate() to read h1/h2 innerText. All contact form fields expose data-testid: contact-name/email/company/message/submit and success state at contact-success. Nav links: nav-link-index/capabilities/studio/contact.
